paper.title_en: Optimal Pulsar Timing Array Strategies with the Deep Synoptic Array
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing array (PTA) experiments have seen evidence for a nanohertz-frequency gravitational wave background (GWB) through coordinated radio timing observations of millisecond pulsars. The significance of this evidence is expected to grow and the GWB's progenitor(s) uncovered with continued observations, especially as the next generation of radio telescopes comes online. We present a framework for simulating timing observations of a set of pulsars with a set of telescopes to predict the per-pulsar optimal instrument, observing frequency, and integration time. We apply this methodology to the NANOGrav source list of 85 pulsars observed with the Green Bank Telescope, Very Large Array, Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME), and the Deep Synoptic Array (DSA), a radio dish array under construction in Nevada. We discuss the dominant noise contributions to the timing precision of these pulsars and show that most are not dominated by intrinsic pulse phase jitter noise. We also determine which pulsars should be timed with DSA and CHIME or only DSA and show that an ab initio DSA PTA is more sensitive than one which uses current instruments. Finally, we solve for the optimal integration time per pulsar, subject to a fixed time budget, that maximizes the GWB signal-to-noise. We show that there is little benefit to optimizing over integration time for these pulsars observed with DSA. Through Monte Carlo realizations of the PTA, we show that the GWB sensitivity improves by $\sim 5\%$ for time-optimized observations compared to the equal-time-per-source scenario with an early-science, fixed source list.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接研究脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）的观测策略，提出一个模拟框架来预测每颗脉冲星的最优仪器、观测频率与积分时间，并将其应用于 NANOGrav 的 85 颗脉冲星源表以及包括 Deep Synoptic Array（DSA）在内的多台射电望远镜。文中还分析了计时精度的主导噪声贡献、给出了 DSA 与 CHIME 的联合计时方案，并通过蒙特卡洛实现量化了时间优化对 GWB 信噪比的提升（约 5%）。方法与结论具体、可复现，对 PTA 观测规划具有直接参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 使用深空瞬变阵列的最优脉冲星计时阵列策略
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）实验通过对毫秒脉冲星进行协同射电计时观测，已经发现了纳赫兹频率引力波背景（GWB）的证据。随着观测的持续，尤其是随着下一代射电望远镜投入使用，这一证据的显著性预计将提高，GWB 的起源天体也将被揭示。我们提出了一个框架，用于模拟一组望远镜对一组脉冲星的计时观测，以预测每颗脉冲星的最优仪器、观测频率和积分时间。我们将这一方法应用于 NANOGrav 的 85 颗脉冲星源表，这些脉冲星由绿岸望远镜、甚大阵、加拿大氢强度测绘实验（CHIME）以及深空瞬变阵列（DSA）观测，DSA 是正在内华达州建造的射电天线阵列。我们讨论了这些脉冲星计时精度的主要噪声贡献，并表明其中大多数并不由内禀脉冲相位抖动噪声主导。我们还确定了哪些脉冲星应使用 DSA 和 CHIME 计时，或仅使用 DSA 计时，并表明从头开始的 DSA PTA 比使用当前仪器的 PTA 更灵敏。最后，我们在固定时间预算约束下，求解每颗脉冲星的最优积分时间，以最大化 GWB 信噪比。我们表明，对于这些用 DSA 观测的脉冲星，在积分时间上进行优化几乎没有益处。通过对 PTA 的蒙特卡洛实现，我们表明，对于早期科学、固定源表的情况，与每源等时间方案相比，时间优化观测使 GWB 灵敏度提高约 $\sim 5\%$。
